production_changes.purpose: Default-false private conductivity switch/Ck and same-force-stage gradient speed cache; no new public switch or independent k state.

law: k_i=k0*exp((J_i-1)/((1-n0)*Ck)); GJ_i=sum_j V0*J_j*(J_j-J_i)*C_i*gradW_ij; Gk_i=k_i*GJ_i/((1-n0)*Ck). Exact k0/J1 shortcuts; reject unrepresentable positive-k states instead of clamping.
rate: p_dot_i=(Kw/n_i)*[-theta_i+(ki/gamma)*(Lp-Gp.dot(Lx)+rho_w*div(Ace))+Gk.dot(Gp+rho_w*Ace_i)/gamma]. Same-stage acceleration is finished before the full assigned rate.
step: Current-ki diffusion plus cached max_i[(Kw/n_i)*abs(Gk_i)/gamma] from the real rate kernel. Preserve the original locked/requested/FixedDt/DtMin rejection policy. This is only a necessary local bound.
